roles.note: one role per spec §3.1 node kind; SOURCE_LOCATION is an object so LOCATED_IN has a terminal; one nominal port `node` per object (GAP-W7 adapter); static_config carries the lid and the observed attrs v1 adds ARGUMENT (27 ARG-* records: premises, a conclusion and evidence — not a CLAIM sub-kind, because typing it as CLAIM would need SUPPORTS [CLAIM, CLAIM] and change what every existing CLAIM→CLAIM edge could mean), DEFEATER (68 DEF-*: 62 of them target something other than a claim, so FALSIFIER — an executable construction that falsifies claim/law semantics — would be stretched, not reused), and INSTRUMENT (12 INS-*: five defeaters target one, and mosaic/evidence.json's own vocabulary says target_type `evidence` resolves in its instruments; there is no witness-targeted defeater at this pin).

object_id_encoding.rule: the kernel requires object_id to match ^\w+$ (GAP-W12); a lid is encoded reversibly: `_` becomes `__`; every other character outside [A-Za-z0-9] becomes `_` followed by two uppercase hex digits per UTF-8 byte; decoding reads `__` as `_` and `_HH` as a byte. The raw lid is also kept in static_config.lid.

enumerations.note: each registry's evidence vocabulary is its own enumeration and is never merged (Q-10); the values are the registry's own tokens carried on evidence_state.token with evidence_state.vocabulary naming the registry

relation_signatures.attributes: the relation record's proposition-level attrs (D-029): relation_field on the six relation-field kinds; from_text/to_text (token-history steps) and typed (typed promotions) on STATE_TRANSITION_OF (D-037; they rode on SUPERSEDES before the ruling); otherwise {}. Occurrence data (assertions) never enters a revision (WRL D8.3).

endpoint_constraints.note: D-037 PAIRS form: each kind lists its allowed [source kind, target kind] pairs explicitly (the former [srcKinds, tgtKinds] product is expanded); `*` = any object kind. Spec §3.2 from → to, widened only where both pins show a real triple (REPRESENTS → LAW: E-46a is a representation record in the CROSS category). SUPERSEDES is frozen as a REPLACEMENT between semantically comparable entities (claim→claim, round→round, transition→transition) stated by a source, never inferred from temporal order; transition → claim is STATE_TRANSITION_OF. WRL refuses a relation whose endpoints are not a listed pair (WRL_UNDECLARED_ENDPOINT_PAIR, from the admitted row); lib/wrl_world.mjs pre-checks the same pairs from this file and names that code. | v1: pairs for a kind v0 already declares are the v0 pairs FOLLOWED BY the v1 ones, so the superset is structural. DISCHARGED_BY [ASSUMPTION, CLAIM] is a new kind rather than a reuse of SUPPORTS [CLAIM, ASSUMPTION] reversed, because widening SUPPORTS' target set costs more than a specific discharge kind; it is minted ONLY where the source's discharge_state.status says the assumption IS discharged (2 of 12 refs at d217ee2 — 7 of 9 records say `undischarged`, and an edge there would invert the source).

The hex is what the kernel WOULD mint for this preimage; only the prefix differs. Labelled adapter; not kernel-minted; not a WRL rel-.
